current.text: He is Miami's starting point guard, and one expert calls his role locked in.
Miami traded for Giannis Antetokounmpo and lost much of its depth and ball handling. Giannis is expected to handle the ball a lot.
His usage is already low and will probably drop further next to Giannis.
Ranked as a tier 9 point guard with an ADP of 114. The expert does not trust his shooting at higher volume.
Experts are lukewarm on him. One lists him among overhyped draft values to avoid, and another does not think he is a particularly strong player.
Miami has the fewest back-to-backs in the league (13) and none in the fantasy playoffs, but only 10 games in the playoff weeks.

durable.text: He plays a very low usage role and is not a high scorer.
Assists are his main fantasy value, with upside to about seven per game.
Experts disagree on his steals. Some call them good or okay, and one says he does not get as many as you would want.
Experts are split on his shooting. One says his efficiency has improved, and another does not trust it at higher volume.

note: He sits right on the edge of our 144-player draft: Yahoo ranks him 110 (3 USD), ESPN ranks him 175 (0 USD), and nobody drafted him in our league last season. At most he is a 1 USD late pick for a team that needs assists and can afford weak points, rebounds and threes. Last season he averaged 6.5 assists at 49.0% FG on low volume, but he adds little else. In the first weeks, check whether his assists hold near 6 to 7 now that Giannis handles the ball. If they slip, he is a waiver player.
